decisions.minimal_recommendation: Document fixture as an adapter without full value equality, or explicitly compare controllers when a future test needs value equality. Do not add __eq__ solely to quiet the warning.

annotation.title: Explicit returns mixed with implicit (fall through) returns
annotation.message: Mixing implicit and explicit returns may indicate an error, as implicit returns always return None.

decisions.minimal_recommendation: If touched, document bool-or-None sentinel or use explicit return None; do not collapse True/None semantics.

decisions.minimal_recommendation: Optional assertLessEqual(a,b), preserving operands and message; not a coverage defect.

annotation.title: Comparison result is always the same
annotation.message: Comparison is always false because count <= 4294967295.

decisions.reason: Exact annotated line234 is count > SIZE_MAX/sizeof(*slots), after line233 count > UINT32_MAX. On 64-bit analysis, the first bound makes the multiplication check redundant; on ARM32 the multiplication bound is essential, while count>UINT32_MAX is redundant. Both jointly enforce ABI-index width and multiplication safety across supported targets.
decisions.minimal_recommendation: Keep both semantic constraints. Optional evaluation reorder: test SIZE_MAX/sizeof(*slots) first, and guard count>UINT32_MAX with #if SIZE_MAX > UINT32_MAX. Do not delete the host64 ABI or ARM32 multiplication boundary.
